title: 9th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/9/2/2026).

Question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Arts, Culture and Heritage Heena Waleed: the total spent by the ministry on activities marking 60 years of independence with a breakdown of costs, details of independence-day activities held outside Malé, and the spending in the atolls shown separately.
From the Speaker's desk: a matter on changes to how members belonging to political parties are represented on Parliament's standing committees.
Continuation of the debate on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Gadhdhoo MP Mohamed Ali.
Continuation of the debate on the Digital Identity Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Alifushi MP Abdul Latheef Abdul Rahman.
Report of the Committee of the Whole House on the bill to amend the Export Import Act of the Maldives (Law No. 31/79).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the heritage minister on independence anniversary spending, raised a change to party representation on committees, continued the digital transformation and digital identity bill debates, and took the whole-house committee report on the Export Import Act amendment.
